State could use odometer readings to calculate mileage tax

Makes sense as more electric cars hit the roads. Here in NZ we have a similar scheme (Road User charges) which applies to diesel vehicles where the diesel doesn't have the tax that petrol does so drivers have to pay the road user charge up front. Currently, EVs don't pay the RUC to encourage people to switch but the government plans to introduce the RUC for EVs when 2% of passenger cars are electric. Countries have to be planning for this change as electric vehicles will quickly take over with the next generation of cheaper cars able to do 200+ miles per charge.
